# Recreation Prompt

Recreate Pocket Blockstead as a portrait-first browser canvas sandbox survival crafting game. Preserve the source mechanics: procedural 32px block terrain, mobile joystick movement/jump, tap-to-gather/build, inventory hotbar, mode toggle, recipe crafting with workbench-gated pick, day cycle, hearts, failure overlay, and respawn. Transform presentation into a cozy Minecraft-inspired mobile maker world with a pixel blocksmith avatar, meadow/cave voxel blocks, square sun/moon, drifting block clouds, readable HUD chips, blocky hotbar, short actionable copy, and catalog-backed optional audio. The game should feel like a player-driven block-building seed where gathering, crafting, survival, and creative placement are the core fantasy.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: mobile canvas sandbox survival/crafting platformer
- objective: gather procedural block resources, craft boards/handles/workbench/pick, place blocks, survive days, and pursue player-driven building goals
- input model: canvas-scoped pointer controls; lower-left drag joystick for movement/jump; tap playfield for gather/build; HUD buttons for craft and mode; hotbar tap selection
- core loop: spawn in procedural terrain, move across blocks, mine nearby resources, collect inventory, craft upgrades, place selected blocks, survive day/night, recover through respawn after failure
- fail/friction state: health hearts can be depleted by falling out of the world; blocked actions include out-of-range taps, hard stone without pick, missing ingredients, no placement room, and workbench-gated recipes

## Protected Mechanics
- Tile grid world, 32px blocks, 128-column procedural terrain, dirt/grass/stone/tree strata, bedrock floor.
- Joystick movement, upward drag jump, gravity, collision resolution, camera follow, interaction range, inventory counts, hotbar selection, gather/build mode toggle, recipe costs, workbench proximity gate, day counter, health and respawn.

## Remix Blueprint
Pocket Blockstead reinterprets the protected loop as a cozy portrait-first Minecraft-like blockstead maker fantasy. The player is a pixel blocksmith explorer harvesting meadow/cave blocks, crafting a workbench and tools, and placing blocks to author a persistent-feeling homestead. Presentation, HUD vocabulary, player drawing, background, block textures, feedback, and mobile UI are transformed while mechanics remain unchanged.
